Re-read RFC 1661 Section 4.6: 'Max-Terminate MUST be configurable, but SHOULD default to two (2) transmissions.' Producer applyTransition still loads s.lcpConfig.MaxTerminate() whenever tr.Actions includes LCPActSTR, sendTerminateRequest decrements via spendRestartCount, and pppconfig.ParseLCP parses max-terminate (1..255). Positive and negative TestConfiguredLCPMaxTerminate verify exact 2 and 4 Terminate-Requests before TO- reaches Closed and early close after 1 request on matching Terminate-Ack. Verdict stands.
